BiblicalUsage: Ochran is the father of Pagiel, captain of the tribe of Asher. In Numbers 1:13 Pagiel the son of Ocran is named among the princes of Israel, and in Numbers 2:27 he leads Asher's camp beside Dan.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ochran is remembered in his son's captaincy, and a father's name rides with the tribe he raised.
